# BakerRisk

> > BakerRisk is an employee-owned risk management and process safety engineering firm providing software solutions, consulting services, and training across oil & gas, petrochemicals, and hazardous industries.

BakerRisk specializes in quantitative risk assessment, process hazard analysis, and consequence modeling through proprietary software tools combined with expert engineering consulting. The company serves global operations with offices across North America, Europe, and the Middle East.

## Key Topics

- Process Safety Management
- Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA)
- Hazard Analysis (HAZOP, LOPA, HAZID)
- Consequence Analysis & Modeling
- Hazardous Area Classification
- Fire & Gas Detection
- Root Cause Analysis
- Functional Safety (SIS/SIL)
- Combustible Dust
- Process Safety Consulting
- Engineering Services
- SafeSite3G
- QRATool
- HACTool
- Risk Management Training

## Software Solutions

- [BakerRisk Software Solutions](https://www.bakerrisk.com/bakerrisk-software-solutions): Overview of proprietary software tools: SafeSite3G, QRATool, HACTool for risk analysis.
- [SafeSite3G - Consequence Analysis Software](https://www.bakerrisk.com/services/safesite3g): SafeSite3G consequence analysis software for chemical hazard simulation and facility siting.
- [QRATool - Quantitative Risk Analysis Software](https://www.bakerrisk.com/services/qratool): QRATool quantitative risk assessment software integrating with SafeSite3G for risk calculation.
- [HACTool - Hazardous Area Classification Software](https://www.bakerrisk.com/services/hactool): HACTool proprietary software automating hazardous area classification per NFPA, IEC, API standards.
- [PHA-Tool - Process Hazards Analysis Software](https://www.bakerrisk.com/services/pha-tool): PHA-Tool comprehensive software for HAZOP, LOPA, HAZID process hazard analysis methodologies.
- [F&GTool - Fire and Gas Detection Mapping Software](https://www.bakerrisk.com/services/fgtool): F&GTool fire and gas detection mapping software for early release detection and prevention.
- [FireHAT - Fire Hazard Analysis Software](https://www.bakerrisk.com/services/firehat): FireHAT proprietary software for fire hazard and mitigation analysis with hydraulic modeling.
- [CATree - Root Cause Analysis Software](https://www.bakerrisk.com/services/catree): CATree root cause analysis software for systematic incident investigation and process safety.
- [MaxLoss - Insurance Risk Software](https://www.bakerrisk.com/services/maxloss): MaxLoss insurance risk software determining maximum loss potential for facility assessment.
